title: Transcriptomics Analysis of RNA from Third Instar Larvae
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rs9d6h6
materials: Statistical bioinformatics analysis used the limma package

steps.title: Extract RNA from Larvae
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from female third instar wandering larvae developed on 1:2 and 1:16 P:C diets (4 replicates per mitotype-diet combination).

substeps.instruction: Use TruSeq kit (Illumina, CA, USA) with poly(A) pull-down

steps.title: Verify RNA Quality
steps.instruction: Verify RNA quality using an Agilent Bioanalyser (Agilent Technologies, CA, USA).

substeps.instruction: Ensure all samples have an RNA Integrity Number greater than 8

steps.title: Sequence RNA Samples
steps.instruction: Sequence samples on an Illumina Hiseq2000 sequencer at the Ramaciotti Center to produce 100 bp paired-end reads, generating at least 80 million read pairs per sample.

steps.title: Map Reads and Assign Genes
steps.instruction: Map reads to the NCBI D. melanogaster genome GCF_000001215.4_Release_6_plus_ISO1_MT and assign them to genes.

steps.title: Filter and Normalize Gene Expression
steps.instruction: Filter and normalize the gene expression data using the edgeR package.

substeps.instruction: Filter out genes that fail to achieve at least 0.25 counts per million in at least 4 samples
Apply Trimmed means of M-values (TMM) scale normalisation

steps.title: Perform Differential Expression Analysis
steps.instruction: Assess differential expression between groups and adjust for technical effects.

substeps.instruction: Estimate extra surrogate variables by performing a singular value decomposition of the residuals, emphasizing highly variable genes
Use empirical Bayes t-statistics for assessment, allowing for an abundance trend in standard errors and robust estimation of Bayesian hyperparameters
Control the false discovery rate (FDR) using Benjamini-Hochberg’s method

steps.title: Conduct Pathway and Heatmap Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform downstream functional and visualization analyses.

substeps.instruction: Conduct KEGG pathway analyses using the kegga function in limma
Batch correct log-count-per-million values using removeBatchEffect() to produce heatmaps
